### [Only urban area with 1 million or more with heavy rail (URBANSIZE == 05)] 
### 5km2 CS cutoff + 100m buffer around polygon (without 8sd exclusion)




## =============================================================================
## Tour/Day-level Activity Space Construction (Hasanzadeh et al. 2017 approach)
## NHTS 2017 | Caregiver travel with/without children
##
## Geographic resolution: Census block-group polygons (TIGER/Line)
## Activity space: Minimum Convex Polygon (MCP)
##   - Home BG polygon buffered 100 m
##   - All destination BG polygons buffered 100 m
##   - Union of buffers -> convex hull
## Outcome: log(area in km^2) at the person-day level
##
## Required NHTS files (in data_dir):
##   hhctbg.csv, tripctbg.csv, trippub.csv, hhpub.csv, perpub.csv
## =============================================================================

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(broom)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

CRS_PROJ <- 5070  # NAD83 / Conus Albers, metres, equal-area
```

```{r load-nhts}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 1. Load NHTS files
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
hhctbg   <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "hhctbg.csv"),  col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
tripctbg <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "tripctbg.csv"),col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
trippub  <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "trippub.csv"), col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
hhpub    <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "hhpub.csv"),   col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
perpub   <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "perpub.csv"),  col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
```

```{r msacat-filter}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 1b. Restrict to MSACAT == "01" households only
##     (all columns were read in as character, so compare against "01",
##      not 1 — double check this matches your NHTS 2017 codebook value)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
n_hh_before <- n_distinct(hhpub$HOUSEID)

hhpub <- hhpub %>% filter(URBANSIZE == "05")

msacat_hh_ids <- hhpub$HOUSEID
perpub <- perpub %>% filter(HOUSEID %in% msacat_hh_ids)

message("Households before MSACAT filter: ", n_hh_before)
message("Households after MSACAT == '01' filter: ", n_distinct(hhpub$HOUSEID))
```

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 2. Household child-count classification
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r child-count-helper}
## Count household members in an age band from the perpub roster
count_age_band <- function(perpub_df, age_lo, age_hi) {
  perpub_df %>%
    mutate(age = as.integer(R_AGE)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(age)) %>%
    group_by(HOUSEID) %>%
    summarise(n = sum(age >= age_lo & age <= age_hi), .groups = "drop")
}

## YOUNGCHILD (ages 0-5) lives only in hhpub — perpub roster excludes u5s
hh_youngchild <- hhpub %>%
  distinct(HOUSEID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  transmute(HOUSEID, YOUNGCHILD = replace_na(as.integer(YOUNGCHILD), 0L))

hh_5_9   <- count_age_band(perpub, 5, 9)   %>% rename(num_5_9   = n)
hh_10_17 <- count_age_band(perpub, 10, 17) %>% rename(num_10_17 = n)

hh_child_count_full <- hh_youngchild %>%
  left_join(hh_5_9,   by = "HOUSEID") %>%
  left_join(hh_10_17, by = "HOUSEID") %>%
  mutate(
    num_5_9          = replace_na(num_5_9, 0L),
    num_10_17        = replace_na(num_10_17, 0L),
    numu10inhh       = YOUNGCHILD + num_5_9,          # ages 0-9
    total_child_0_17 = numu10inhh + num_10_17
  )
```

```{r child-group-classify}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Classify households:
##   no_child   : total_child_0_17 == 0        (no kids 0-17 at all)
##   with_child : numu10inhh >= 1               (has a child 0-9)
##   (HHs with only 10-17 kids and no 0-9 kids fall into neither group
##    and are excluded from the comparison sample)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
hh_group <- hh_child_count_full %>%
  mutate(
    child_group = case_when(
      total_child_0_17 == 0 ~ "no_child",
      numu10inhh >= 1       ~ "with_child",
      TRUE                  ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

message("No-child households:        ", sum(hh_group$child_group == "no_child", na.rm = TRUE))
message("With-child households:      ", sum(hh_group$child_group == "with_child", na.rm = TRUE))
message("Excluded (only 10-17 kids): ", sum(is.na(hh_group$child_group) & hh_group$total_child_0_17 > 0))
```

```{r hh-controls}
## Household-level control variables
hh_controls <- hhpub %>%
  distinct(HOUSEID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  transmute(
    HOUSEID,
    NUMADLT  = as.integer(NUMADLT),
    HHVEHCNT = as.integer(HHVEHCNT),
    HHFAMINC,
    HHSIZE   = as.integer(HHSIZE),
    URBRUR, MSACAT, HH_CBSA, LIF_CYC,
    veh_per_adult = if_else(NUMADLT > 0, HHVEHCNT / NUMADLT, NA_real_)
  )

## Flag other caregiving-relevant dependents so "no_child" isn't contaminated
hh_other_deps <- perpub %>%
  mutate(age = as.integer(R_AGE)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(age)) %>%
  group_by(HOUSEID) %>%
  summarise(
    has_child_10_15 = any(age >= 10 & age <= 15, na.rm = TRUE),
    has_elderly_70p = any(age >= 70, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r hh-compare-clean}
## Combine into the final household comparison frame.
## "no_child" households that actually have other dependents (older kids or
## elderly) are dropped, so no_child cleanly means "no dependents at all."
hh_compare_clean <- hh_group %>%
  filter(child_group %in% c("no_child", "with_child")) %>%
  left_join(hh_controls,   by = "HOUSEID") %>%
  left_join(hh_other_deps, by = "HOUSEID") %>%
  mutate(
    has_child_10_15 = replace_na(has_child_10_15, FALSE),
    has_elderly_70p = replace_na(has_elderly_70p, FALSE)
  ) %>%
  filter(!(child_group == "no_child" & (has_child_10_15 | has_elderly_70p)))

message("Clean no-child HHs:   ", sum(hh_compare_clean$child_group == "no_child"))
message("Clean with-child HHs: ", sum(hh_compare_clean$child_group == "with_child"))

compare_hh_ids <- hh_compare_clean$HOUSEID
```

```{r person-balance-check}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 3. Balance check on adult respondents (23-69) — descriptive only,
##    not used further downstream (trip_core_cmp restricts independently).
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
person_core <- perpub %>%
  mutate(age = as.integer(R_AGE)) %>%
  filter(age >= 23, age <= 69) %>%
  select(HOUSEID, PERSONID, R_AGE = age, R_SEX_IMP, WORKER) %>%
  inner_join(hh_compare_clean, by = "HOUSEID")

person_core %>%
  group_by(child_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n              = n(),
    mean_age       = mean(R_AGE, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_worker     = mean(WORKER == "01", na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_hhfaminc  = mean(as.integer(HHFAMINC), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_veh_adult = mean(veh_per_adult, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_urban      = mean(URBRUR == "01", na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 4. Trip-level frame restricted to the comparison households
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r trip-core}
trip_core_cmp <- trippub %>%
  filter(
    HOUSEID %in% compare_hh_ids,
    as.integer(R_AGE_IMP) >= 23,
    as.integer(R_AGE_IMP) <= 69
  ) %>%
  select(
    HOUSEID, PERSONID, TDTRPNUM, WHYTO, WHYFROM, TDWKND,
    R_AGE_IMP, R_SEX_IMP, DRIVER, WORKER,
    HHVEHCNT, HHFAMINC, HHSIZE, NUMADLT, LIF_CYC,
    URBRUR, MSACAT, HH_CBSA, WTTRDFIN
  ) %>%
  mutate(trip_num = as.integer(TDTRPNUM)) %>%
  arrange(HOUSEID, PERSONID, trip_num) %>%
  left_join(hh_group %>% select(HOUSEID, child_group), by = "HOUSEID") %>%
  filter(!is.na(child_group))
```

```{r geoids}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 5. GEOIDs for home and destination block groups
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
hhctbg_geo <- hhctbg %>%
  filter(HOUSEID %in% compare_hh_ids) %>%
  transmute(
    HOUSEID,
    home_geoid = paste0(
      str_pad(HHSTFIPS, 2, "left", "0"),
      str_pad(HHCNTYFP, 3, "left", "0"),
      str_pad(HHCT,     6, "left", "0"),
      str_pad(HHBG,     1, "left", "0")
    )
  )

tripctbg_geo <- tripctbg %>%
  filter(DEST_COUNTRY == "USA", HOUSEID %in% compare_hh_ids) %>%
  transmute(
    HOUSEID, PERSONID, TDTRPNUM,
    dest_geoid = paste0(
      str_pad(DEST_ST,   2, "left", "0"),
      str_pad(DEST_CNTY, 3, "left", "0"),
      str_pad(DEST_CT,   6, "left", "0"),
      str_pad(DEST_BG,   1, "left", "0")
    )
  )
```

```{r download-bg-polygons}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 6. Download block-group polygons (once) and buffer 100 m
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
all_geoids  <- union(hhctbg_geo$home_geoid, tripctbg_geo$dest_geoid)
state_codes <- unique(substr(all_geoids, 1, 2))

message("Downloading Census BG polygons for ", length(state_codes), " states ...")

bg_poly_sf <- map_dfr(state_codes, function(st) {
  tryCatch(
    block_groups(state = st, year = 2017, progress_bar = FALSE) %>% select(GEOID),
    error = function(e) {
      message("  FAILED for state ", st, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    }
  )
})

if (nrow(bg_poly_sf) == 0) {
  stop("bg_poly_sf is empty — check tempdir()/TIGRIS_CACHE_DIR (see one-time-env-fix chunk).")
}
message("Total BG polygons downloaded: ", nrow(bg_poly_sf))

bg_poly_matched <- bg_poly_sf %>%
  filter(GEOID %in% all_geoids) %>%
  st_transform(CRS_PROJ)

message("BG polygons matched: ", nrow(bg_poly_matched), " of ", length(all_geoids))

bg_buf_lookup <- bg_poly_matched %>%
  mutate(geometry = st_buffer(geometry, dist = 100)) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  select(GEOID) %>%
  distinct(GEOID, .keep_all = TRUE)

## Unbuffered areas, needed later for the urban/<=10km^2 eligibility filter
bg_area <- bg_poly_matched %>%
  mutate(area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()
```

```{r person-day-geoids}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 7. Assemble the set of GEOIDs visited per person-day (home + all stops)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
person_dest_geoids <- trip_core_cmp %>%
  select(HOUSEID, PERSONID, TDTRPNUM) %>%
  left_join(tripctbg_geo, by = c("HOUSEID", "PERSONID", "TDTRPNUM")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dest_geoid)) %>%
  distinct(HOUSEID, PERSONID, dest_geoid)

person_day_geoids <- person_dest_geoids %>%
  rename(geoid = dest_geoid) %>%
  bind_rows(
    trip_core_cmp %>%
      distinct(HOUSEID, PERSONID) %>%
      left_join(hhctbg_geo, by = "HOUSEID") %>%
      rename(geoid = home_geoid) %>%
      filter(!is.na(geoid))
  ) %>%
  distinct(HOUSEID, PERSONID, geoid)

message("Person-days to process: ",
        n_distinct(paste(person_day_geoids$HOUSEID, person_day_geoids$PERSONID)))
```

```{r compute-mcp}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 8. Compute daily MCP area: union of buffered BG polygons -> convex hull
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
compute_daily_mcp_area <- function(geoid_vec) {
  polys <- bg_buf_lookup %>% filter(GEOID %in% geoid_vec)
  if (nrow(polys) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(st_area(st_convex_hull(st_union(polys)))) / 1e6  # km^2
}

daily_spaces <- person_day_geoids %>%
  group_by(HOUSEID, PERSONID) %>%
  group_modify(~ tibble(activity_space_km2 = compute_daily_mcp_area(.x$geoid))) %>%
  ungroup()

message("Daily activity spaces computed: ", nrow(daily_spaces))
```

```{r eligibility-resample}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 9. Resample: URBAN only, home & all destination BGs <= 20 km^2.
##    Drops the ENTIRE person-day if home OR any single destination BG
##    exceeds 20 km^2 (no trimming/capping of the polygon itself).
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
home_info <- hhctbg_geo %>%
  left_join(bg_area %>% select(GEOID, area_km2), by = c("home_geoid" = "GEOID")) %>%
  rename(home_area_km2 = area_km2) %>%
  left_join(hh_compare_clean %>% select(HOUSEID, URBRUR), by = "HOUSEID")

dest_max_area <- person_day_geoids %>%
  left_join(bg_area %>% select(GEOID, area_km2), by = c("geoid" = "GEOID")) %>%
  group_by(HOUSEID, PERSONID) %>%
  summarise(max_dest_area_km2 = max(area_km2, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

daily_spaces_resampled <- daily_spaces %>%
  left_join(home_info %>% select(HOUSEID, home_area_km2, URBRUR), by = "HOUSEID") %>%
  left_join(dest_max_area, by = c("HOUSEID", "PERSONID")) %>%
  mutate(
    eligible = !is.na(URBRUR) & URBRUR == "01" &
      !is.na(home_area_km2) & home_area_km2 <= 5 &
      !is.na(max_dest_area_km2) & max_dest_area_km2 <= 5
  ) %>%
  filter(eligible) %>%
  select(HOUSEID, PERSONID, activity_space_km2)

message("Person-days retained after urban + <=20km^2 resampling: ", nrow(daily_spaces_resampled))
```

```{r outlier-exclusion, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 10. Outlier exclusion: drop activity spaces beyond mean + 8*SD
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
as_mean <- mean(daily_spaces_resampled$activity_space_km2, na.rm = TRUE)
as_sd   <- sd(daily_spaces_resampled$activity_space_km2,   na.rm = TRUE)
message("Mean: ", round(as_mean, 2), " km^2, SD: ", round(as_sd, 2),
        ", 8-SD threshold: ", round(as_mean + 8 * as_sd, 2), " km^2")

daily_spaces_resampled <- daily_spaces_resampled %>%
  filter(!is.na(activity_space_km2), activity_space_km2 <= as_mean + 8 * as_sd)

message("Retained after outlier exclusion: ", nrow(daily_spaces_resampled))

daily_spaces_resampled %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(), mean_as = mean(activity_space_km2), median_as = median(activity_space_km2),
    sd_as = sd(activity_space_km2), max_as = max(activity_space_km2),
    p99_as = quantile(activity_space_km2, 0.99)
  )
```

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## NOTE on TDWKND: your source script used TDWKND == "02" in one place and
## TDWKND == "01" in another, with a comment confirming "01 = weekend."
## This rewrite uses "01" = weekend throughout — re-verify against the
## NHTS 2017 codebook before trusting the weekend/weekday results below.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r day-summary}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 11. Final person-day model dataset (single build — no re-patching)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
income_quartile_recode <- function(income_cat) {
  income_num <- as.integer(income_cat)
  if_else(income_num %in% c(-7, -8, -9), NA_integer_, income_num)
}

day_summary <- trip_core_cmp %>%
  group_by(HOUSEID, PERSONID) %>%
  summarise(
    n_trips     = n(),
    weekend     = any(TDWKND == "01", na.rm = TRUE),   # "01" = weekend
    age         = as.integer(first(R_AGE_IMP)),
    female      = first(R_SEX_IMP) == "02",
    driver      = first(DRIVER) == "01",
    worker      = first(WORKER) == "01",
    veh_cnt     = as.integer(first(HHVEHCNT)),
    no_vehicle  = first(HHVEHCNT) == "0",
    hh_size     = as.integer(first(HHSIZE)),
    n_adults    = as.integer(first(NUMADLT)),
    income_cat  = first(HHFAMINC),
    lif_cyc     = first(LIF_CYC),
    urbrur      = first(URBRUR),
    msacat      = first(MSACAT),
    wt_trip     = first(WTTRDFIN),
    child_group = first(child_group),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(daily_spaces_resampled, by = c("HOUSEID", "PERSONID")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(activity_space_km2)) %>%
  mutate(
    log_as_km2 = log(activity_space_km2),
    income_num = income_quartile_recode(income_cat)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(income_num)) %>%   # drop refused/don't know/not ascertained
  mutate(
    income_quartile = ntile(income_num, 4),
    income_quartile = factor(income_quartile, levels = 1:4,
                              labels = c("Q1_lowest", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4_highest")),
    msacat  = factor(msacat),
    weekend = factor(weekend, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE), labels = c("weekday", "weekend"))
  )

message("Final person-day dataset: ", nrow(day_summary), " rows")
day_summary %>% count(child_group)
table(day_summary$income_quartile, useNA = "ifany")
table(day_summary$weekend, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r descriptives}
print(desc_by_group_weekend)
```

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 13. Regression models (OLS)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r models}
m1_unadjusted <- lm(log_as_km2 ~ child_group, data = day_summary)

m2_adjusted <- lm(
  log_as_km2 ~ child_group + age + female + worker + no_vehicle +
    hh_size + n_adults + income_quartile,
  data = day_summary
)

m3_weekend_additive <- lm(
  log_as_km2 ~ child_group + weekend + age + female + worker + no_vehicle +
    hh_size + n_adults + income_quartile,
  data = day_summary
)

## child_group x weekend interaction: lets the child-presence effect on
## activity space differ between weekday and weekend
m4_weekend_interaction <- lm(
  log_as_km2 ~ child_group * weekend + age + female + worker + no_vehicle +
    hh_size + n_adults + income_quartile,
  data = day_summary
)

summary(m1_unadjusted)
summary(m2_adjusted)
summary(m3_weekend_additive)
summary(m4_weekend_interaction)

## Does the interaction significantly improve fit over the additive model?
anova(m3_weekend_additive, m4_weekend_interaction)
```

```{r stratified-models}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 14. Stratified models (weekday-only / weekend-only) — alternative to the
##     interaction term; lets ALL coefficients, not just child_group, differ
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
m_weekday_only <- lm(
  log_as_km2 ~ child_group + age + female + worker + no_vehicle +
    hh_size + n_adults + income_quartile,
  data = day_summary %>% filter(weekend == "weekday")
)

m_weekend_only <- lm(
  log_as_km2 ~ child_group + age + female + worker + no_vehicle +
    hh_size + n_adults + income_quartile,
  data = day_summary %>% filter(weekend == "weekend")
)

summary(m_weekday_only)
summary(m_weekend_only)

bind_rows(
  tidy(m_weekday_only) %>% mutate(sample = "weekday"),
  tidy(m_weekend_only) %>% mutate(sample = "weekend")
) %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "child_group")) %>%
  select(sample, term, estimate, std.error, p.value)
```




```{r}
## =============================================================================
## Distribution of activity space area (km^2) — raw scale
## =============================================================================

ggplot(day_summary, aes(x = activity_space_km2)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Daily Activity Space Area",
    x = "Activity space area (km^2)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

## Given the skew you've seen throughout this analysis, a log-scale version
## will likely be more interpretable:
ggplot(day_summary, aes(x = activity_space_km2)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Daily Activity Space Area (log scale)",
    x = "Activity space area (km^2, log scale)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

## Split by child_group, to visually compare the two groups directly
ggplot(day_summary, aes(x = activity_space_km2, fill = child_group)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60, alpha = 0.6, position = "identity") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Activity Space Area by Household Type",
    x = "Activity space area (km^2, log scale)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Household type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

## Alternative: boxplot, often clearer than overlapping histograms for
## comparing two groups' distributions (including median, IQR, outliers)
ggplot(day_summary, aes(x = child_group, y = activity_space_km2, fill = child_group)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Activity Space Area by Household Type",
    x = "Household type",
    y = "Activity space area (km^2, log scale)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
  geom_histogram(bins = 1000) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1000)) +   # <-- adjust upper bound as needed
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Daily Activity Space Area (zoomed, 0-5 km^2)",
    x = "Activity space area (km^2)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1000000))

quantile(day_summary$activity_space_km2, probs = c(0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 0.95, 0.99, 1), na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(day_summary, aes(x = activity_space_km2, fill = child_group)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 1000, alpha = 0.6, position = "identity") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 5)) +
  labs(
    title = "Activity Space Area by Household Type (zoomed, 0-5 km^2)",
    x = "Activity space area (km^2)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Household type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
## =============================================================================
## Table version: activity space area distribution, binned
## =============================================================================

## 1. Simple bin table (fixed-width bins from 0 to a chosen upper bound)
day_summary %>%
  mutate(
    area_bin = cut(
      activity_space_km2,
      breaks = seq(0, 5, by = 0.5),   # adjust range/width as needed
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  count(area_bin) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 2))

## 2. Same binning, but split by child_group side by side
day_summary %>%
  mutate(
    area_bin = cut(
      activity_space_km2,
      breaks = seq(0, 5, by = 0.5),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  count(child_group, area_bin) %>%
  group_by(child_group) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 2)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = child_group, values_from = c(n, pct))

## 3. Percentile table (often more informative than fixed bins for skewed data)
quantile(
  day_summary$activity_space_km2,
  probs = c(0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 0.95, 0.99, 1),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

## 4. Percentile table split by child_group
day_summary %>%
  group_by(child_group) %>%
  summarise(
    p0   = quantile(activity_space_km2, 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    p5   = quantile(activity_space_km2, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    p10  = quantile(activity_space_km2, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    p25  = quantile(activity_space_km2, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    p50_median = quantile(activity_space_km2, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    p75  = quantile(activity_space_km2, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    p90  = quantile(activity_space_km2, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    p95  = quantile(activity_space_km2, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    p99  = quantile(activity_space_km2, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE),
    p100_max = quantile(activity_space_km2, 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

## 5. Wider bins across the FULL range (not just zoomed) — useful for seeing
##    the whole shape including the tail, without a chart
day_summary %>%
  mutate(
    area_bin = cut(
      activity_space_km2,
      breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 500, 1000, Inf),
      labels = c("0-1", "1-2", "2-5", "5-10", "10-20", "20-50",
                 "50-100", "100-500", "500-1000", "1000+"),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  count(area_bin) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 2))
```
